description: "Glimpses of Three Coasts" by Helen Hunt Jackson is a collection of travel essays written in the late 19th century. This work explores various landscapes and cultures across California, Oregon, Scotland, England, Norway, Denmark, and Germany, focusing on the author’s observations and experiences as she journeys through these regions.
